caption: The drawing features four metallic objects set against a plain, light-colored background. At the top are two round escutcheons with decorative, openwork borders. The left round plate has a vertical slot and a keyhole, while the right one has a central locking mechanism with a bolt and lever. Both plates are dark brownish-black in color, with metallic highlights suggesting wear or patina. Below them are two elongated objects: the upper one appears to be a hinge or bracket with a paddle-like end, a joint in the middle, and another elongated metal section; the color is consistent with the top objects, showing dark metallic brown tones. The lower elongated object, more slender and slightly curved, features an ornate handle and what looks like a stirrup or foot-operated mechanism at the right end, also rendered in a dark metallic hue. The arrangement of the objects is orderly, with the round plates at the top and the elongated pieces parallel beneath them.
title: Chest Lock and Hasp
